name: Ioxitalamic Acid

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in Germany, first in 1998 — for blood vessel problems, kidney harm and heart harm

similar.name: Iohexol
problems: Carries a boxed warning in United States — for misuse or addiction

examples.title: Impact of Oral Contrast in the Large Intestine on the Recognition of Appendix

summary: Ioxitalamic Acid was removed from the market in Germany starting in 1998 due to damage to blood vessels, kidney damage (nephrotoxicity), and heart harm [3]. In addition, a similar drug named Iohexol carries a boxed warning in the United States concerning misuse [4]. A small computer model, rather than tests on people, calculated low scores for both liver and heart risks [M].
